elements.name: Motif Memory
elements.description: Sets up an agent's external memory, with the roles, workflow and design guidelines you choose

elements.name: Developer
elements.description: Chooses the roles, workflow and design guidelines that suit their way of working, and sets up their agent's memory

elements.name: Memory Repo
elements.description: The starter memory, on the Developer's computer: Markdown files the Developer makes into a git repo of its own

adapters.name: Web App
adapters.description: The setup page and the catalogue: pick roles, order the workflow stages, pick guidelines from packs, and write the memory out; or view and download a single role or pack

adapters.name: Specs
adapters.description: Checks that drive the application through the User port, using the fake driven adapters

ports.name: Memory Files
ports.description: Writes the starter memory's Markdown files out

adapters.name: Browser Files
adapters.technology: Folder picker or zip download (JS interop)
adapters.description: Writes the files into a folder the Developer picks, or downloads them as a zip where the browser can't

ports.name: Memory Content
ports.description: Reads the role and pack texts the memory is made from

adapters.name: Bundled Content
adapters.description: Reads the Markdown in Content/, embedded in the adapter as resources
